title: Noon project configuration
description: Shared noon.yaml configuration. Use noon config check for schedule, duration, timezone, agent resolution, and YAML-specific validation.

definitions.description: File-local reusable YAML fragments. Validated against the Noon schema wherever referenced.

timezone.description: Local, UTC, or an IANA timezone name such as America/Denver.

jobs.description: Named jobs. Omit schedule for manual-only jobs.

command.description: A shell command string or exact argv list. The executable must not be blank; later arguments may be empty.

hook.description: A shell command or argv list; an empty list disables the user-default hook.

schedule.description: Cron, macro, calendar phrase, or interval; validated by noon config check.

splay.description: Stable forward offset window, 1s to 1h; requires a cron, macro, or calendar schedule. Validated by noon config check.

noop_exit_code.description: Exit code from 1 to 124 that a run job uses to report that it had nothing to do.

prompt.description: Inline agent prompt, at most 64 KiB in UTF-8 bytes (checked by Noon).

prompt_file.description: Project-relative prompt file; read at run time, at most 64 KiB.

agent.description: Agent profile for prompt jobs; defaults to the machine's default_agent.

agent_args.description: Literal argv for a prompt job. Requires an explicit agent; values are not templated or expanded.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to the project root.

env.description: Variables overlaid on the inherited environment. Scheduled runs inherit the scheduler's minimal environment, not your shell's: TERM, SHELL, and shell rc exports are usually unset. Quote numbers; NOON_* names are reserved.

timeout.description: Duration of at least 1s, or none; validated by noon config check.

overlap.description: Skip overlapping runs or keep at most one pending run.

requests.description: Merge due-now requests into an existing due run, or queue each separately with a per-job due-now cap of 20 queued runs.

missed.description: How to handle schedules missed during sleep or downtime.

os.description: Operating systems on which this job may run.

arch.description: Architectures on which this job may run.

cooldown.description: Minimum gap between queued requests, at least 1s; validated by noon config check. Incompatible with requests: each.

secret_env.description: Environment variable containing the webhook secret.
